340B savings help support University Hospitals’ overall capacity to provide community benefit, which totaled $511 million in 2024. These resources play an important role in sustaining a wide range of programs and services that benefit our patients and community. These supports include:

Financial assistance for patients who are unable to afford hospital care, physician care and/or medications
Medication access services to help patients navigate insurance requirements and reduce financial barriers
Patient engagement programs focused on refill management and improving adherence to therapy
Clinical services, including pharmacists embedded in provider offices and ongoing care management
Education and training by preparing future generations of caregivers
Transportation assistance
Home health services
Community outreach initiatives
Medicaid shortfall and other uncompensated care
Support for medical research
In-kind contributions to community organizations
